title.es: Aquel en el que muere Pelayo

description.es: Pelayo se dirige a su cita con Marta cuando nota que alguien lo sigue. Álvaro se le enfrenta en nombre de Beatriz y lo amenaza, sin embargo, Pelayo lo reconoce de un crimen en México y forcejean. A pesar de sus súplicas, Álvaro lo apuñala. Marta, al llegar a los jardines, escucha sus gritos y corre a ayudarlo, pero es demasiado tarde: en su lecho de muerte, Pelayo solo alcanza a decirle que había algo importante que debía saber y que por favor lo perdone.
description.en: Pelayo is on his way to meet Marta when he notices someone following him. Álvaro confronts him on Beatriz's behalf and threatens him; however, Pelayo recognizes him from a crime in Mexico, and they struggle. Despite his pleas, Álvaro stabs him. Marta, arriving at the gardens, hears his cries and rushes to help him, but it's too late: on his deathbed, Pelayo only manages to tell her that there was something important she needed to know, and to please forgive him.
